title: Perspective on AI and quantum open-source software
authors: Changhao Li, Bradley A. Chase, Veena Vijayakumar, Mathys Rennela, Alessandro Cosentino, **Naixu Guo**, Sebastian Hassinger, Farrokh Labib, Seun Omonije, Patrick Rebentrost, Vincent Russo, Nathan Shammah, William J. Zeng, Ben Castanon
summary: Verification practices and contribution standards for AI-assisted quantum open-source software, informed by public repositories and community surveys.
